name: Gallipoli bridgehead
summary: Crossing from the Dardanelles into Thrace.

name: Ottoman Campaign Against Hormuz
summary: Piri Reis and Seydi Ali Reis led naval expeditions and campaigns from Suez through the Red Sea and Persian Gulf against Portuguese strongholds at Muscat, Hormuz, and the Strait of Hormuz, ultimately reaching Basra.

name: Ottoman Counter-Campaign to Varna
summary: Sultan Murad II's rapid movement from Edirne to intercept the Crusader army at Varna.

name: Kosovo campaign
summary: Balkan advance toward Kosovo Polje.

name: Constantinople campaign
summary: Mehmed II's final advance on the Byzantine capital.

name: Albanian campaigns
summary: Long Ottoman-Venetian and Skanderbeg-era struggle in Albania.

name: Mohacs campaign
summary: Belgrade to Mohacs and Buda.

name: Vienna campaign
summary: The Danube road toward Vienna in 1529 and 1683.

name: Moscow raid
summary: Devlet I Giray's massive raid into Muscovy, resulting in the burning of Moscow.

name: Podolia campaign
summary: Ottoman-Commonwealth war route to Kamianets.

name: Wallachian campaigns
summary: Campaigns across the lower Danube and Wallachia.

name: Aegean naval war
summary: Preveza, Lepanto, Cyprus, Rhodes, and Candia in the Mediterranean struggle.

name: Sinan Pasha's Relief Expedition to Hatvan and Esztergom (1594)
summary: Grand Vizier Koca Sinan Pasha's relief expedition from Belgrade to relieve the sieges of Esztergom and Hatvan during the Long Turkish War.

name: Köprülü Fazıl Ahmed Pasha's Campaign to Novi Zrin and Saint Gotthard (1663–1664)
summary: Grand Vizier Köprülü Fazıl Ahmed Pasha's major campaign during the Austro-Turkish War, culminating in the destruction of the fortress of Novi Zrin and the Battle of Saint Gotthard.

name: Koca Sinan Pasha's Campaign to Győr, Szentmárton, and Komárom (1594)
summary: Grand Vizier Koca Sinan Pasha's campaign during the Long Turkish War resulting in the capture of Győr (Raab) and Szentmárton (St. Marton), though checked at Komárom.

name: Sultan Mehmed II's Campaign to Trabzon (1461)
summary: Sultan Mehmed II's joint land and naval expedition that successfully conquered the Empire of Trebizond, bringing the southern Black Sea coast under permanent Ottoman control.

name: Köprülü Fazıl Mustafa Pasha's Counter-Offensive Campaign to Belgrade (1690)
summary: Grand Vizier Köprülü Fazıl Mustafa Pasha's successful counter-offensive campaign during the Great Turkish War that recaptured Belgrade and pushed Habsburg forces out of Serbia.

name: Hadım Suleiman Pasha's Naval Expedition to Diu (1538)
summary: Ottoman naval expedition led by Governor of Egypt Hadım Suleiman Pasha into the Indian Ocean to dislodge the Portuguese from the strategic fort of Diu, marking a major clash of empires in western India.

name: Campaign against Astrakhan
summary: Ottoman and Crimean attempt to recover Astrakhan from Russian control.

name: Ottoman Campaign against Kiliya and Akkerman
summary: Bayezid II's major Black Sea campaign against the Moldavian fortresses of Kiliya and Akkerman. The Ottoman army advanced from the Balkans through Wallachia toward the lower Danube, captured Kiliya at the Danube delta, and then moved west along the Black Sea coast to besiege and capture Akkerman on the Dniester estuary.

name: Campaign of Chaldiran
summary: Selim I's campaign against the Safavids, culminating in the Battle of Chaldiran.

name: Ottoman Campaign towards Lviv
summary: Ottoman expedition against the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth involving the siege of Kamianets and advance toward Lviv.

name: Sultan Murad IV's Yerevan Campaign
summary: Sultan Murad IV's personal campaign into the Caucasus, successfully capturing Yerevan (Revan) and plundering Tabriz.

name: Ottoman Campaign against Timur (Ankara)
summary: Bayezid I's confrontation with Timur, ending at the Battle of Ankara.

name: Szigetvár Expedition (1566)
summary: Suleiman the Magnificent's final campaign starting from Banat, targeting Szigetvár.

name: Chyhyryn Campaign (1678)
summary: Ottoman advance from the southern plains to capture Chyhyryn.

name: Vienna Campaign (1529)
summary: The first major Ottoman attempt to capture Vienna, marking the high-water mark of their expansion into Central Europe under Suleiman the Magnificent.

name: Campaign against Malta
summary: Ottoman naval expedition to capture the island of Malta from the Knights Hospitaller.

name: Eger Campaign (1596)
summary: Major Ottoman expedition led by Mehmed III, moving through the Balkans to capture the fortress of Eger.

name: Bosnasaray to Eger Route (1596)
summary: Military movement of Bosnian provincial forces joining the main Ottoman army at Belgrade en route to Eger.

name: Oradea Campaign (1660)
summary: Ottoman expedition from Edirne to capture the strategic fortress of Oradea (Nagyvárad).

name: Nové Zámky Campaign (1663)
summary: Expedition launched by Grand Vizier Köprülüzade Fazıl Ahmed Pasha to secure the fortress of Nové Zámky (Uyvar).

name: Bosnia Campaign (1388)
summary: Early Ottoman military movement to secure influence in the central Balkans and the Bosnian interior during the reign of Murad I, staging through the administrative hub of Pristina.

name: Selim I's Mamluk Campaign (1516–1517)
summary: Selim I's decisive campaign ending Mamluk rule, incorporating Syria, Palestine, and Egypt into the Ottoman Empire.

name: Osman II's Khotyn Campaign (1621)
summary: Sultan Osman II's personal expedition to annex Polish Ukraine and neutralize Cossack raids.

name: Transylvanian Campaign (1551)
summary: Ottoman intervention under Sokollu Mehmed Pasha to reassert control over Transylvania after Habsburg maneuvers.

name: Murad IV's Mesopotamian Campaign (1638)
summary: Murad IV's grand campaign to recapture Baghdad and solidify Ottoman control over Mesopotamia, finalized by the Treaty of Zuhab.

name: Crimean Campaign (Burning of Moscow)
summary: Devlet I Giray's massive raid into Muscovy, resulting in the burning of Moscow.
